scope: Optional structural shortcut within the existing translation implementation

implementation.projector: Same detached eigenspace estimated from normalized/modulated H, reused for branch decomposition and the raw-X shortcut
implementation.zero_gate_behavior: Enabled blocks project X; the default identity shortcut is intentionally not retained
implementation.paper_alignment: Adaptation of the structural-shortcut idea, not a literal full implementation of every manuscript equation and setting

runtime_tests.workflow_matrix: Two tasks x P2/P4/P8 x main_structure false/true
runtime_tests.workflow_fixture: Small-width model, full latent grid, IO-only fake AE
checks: Independent per-window projection oracle, including padding and gradient boundaries
Same eigenspace reused without a second eigendecomposition
Default parameter values, RNG consumption and outputs unchanged
YAML and CLI precedence, explicit disabling, boolean validation
Mode-specific run names, persisted contracts, cross-mode resume rejection
Original-schema checkpoint migration, real optimizer/RNG resume and best-EMA export
Resumed P8 training matches uninterrupted training in both modes
Prediction remains independent of held-out target and mask changes

documentation_tests.note: These pre-existing documentation failures remain visible. The new validation link was checked after this report was created.

limitations: No full-dataset convergence, comparative quality improvement or paper-result reproduction has been established.
The flag changes only the shortcut in active MDSA blocks, not the condition/feature joint Gram projector, all-block placement, rank, d124 operators or training/sampling settings.
Learned branch outputs are not constrained to remain in the input subspaces.
The existing qualitative images are not results of this new mode.
Measured CUDA allocations exceed physical VRAM on this Windows host; this is not a guarantee of fitting in 10 GiB on another system.
